LMO.Set.EnabledHint: Every file uploaded through Foundry's file picker is converted before it is stored.
LMO.Set.ImageMaxDimHint: Larger images are scaled down. 0 = never scale. Smaller images are never enlarged.
LMO.Set.VideoMaxHeightHint: Taller videos are scaled down. 0 = never scale. Video conversion runs in real time on your CPU/GPU and can take a while.
LMO.Set.KeepIfLarger: Keep the original when the result is not smaller
LMO.Failed: Could not optimize {name} ({msg}); uploading the original.
LMO.Bulk.Title: Optimize folder
LMO.Bulk.RefsHint: Scenes, actors, items, journals, playlists, tables, macros and cards that point to a converted file are switched to the new file. Compendiums are not touched. Originals are always kept (Foundry cannot delete files).
LMO.Bulk.OnlyData: Bulk optimization works on the User Data source only.
LMO.Bulk.Nothing: Nothing to optimize in this folder.
LMO.Bulk.Done: Converted {ok} of {n} files, saved {saved}. {failed} failed, {skipped} skipped.
LMO.Bulk.RefsConfirm: {count} references in {docs} documents point to converted files. Update them?
LMO.Bulk.Protected: Folders inside modules/ and systems/ are never optimized.
